% is points won as a share of points available (12 a win, 4 a draw, 6 a tie, less any points docked for slow over rates). Best possible is the % a team finishes on if it wins every Test it has left. The top two at the end of the cycle play the final. Through and out follow from the points alone; points docked later could still change them. “In own hands”: win every Test they have left and they finish in the top two, whatever happens elsewhere.
